children: Volkswagen said that Marianne Heiss has been appointed to the automaker's supervisory board with immediate effect, taking a vacant shareholder representative seat.
Heiss was also elected as chair of the audit committee on Thursday.
The appointments come a day before the board is due to meet and vote on a new large-scale restructuring plan.
Heiss previously served on the supervisory board between 2018 and 2025 and is a member of several supervisory and advisory boards, including Audi and Porsche SE.

"She brings extensive expertise to the work of the supervisory board, not only in the fields of finance and accounting, corporate strategy and management, but also in environmental, social and governance issues," said Hans Dieter Poetsch, supervisory board chair.
